_source: GET /api/debug/llm/local-models/gpt-oss-120b/slots on the live box, 2026-09-18, build b10629-eab8ee41f, after a jerv prime. Verbatim except id_task (a per-process counter). _why: Every KV test used to hand-write a slot dict with the THREE keys the code reads, while a real body has ten plus three nested objects. That made the fakes agree with the module docstring instead of testing against llama.cpp — and the suite could not tell 'llama.cpp behaves as documented' from 'the fake was written to match the docstring'. test_prefill.py already carries verbatim captures for exactly this reason, after three attempts shipped dead against a guessed shape.
